mechanisms.description: The order ends on its own terms: a stated expiry date (withdrawals 'until March 5, 19xx' in aid of a pending bill) or a stated period ('for the period of ninety days from the date hereof').
mechanisms.effective_date_rule: The stated date, or the order date plus the stated period.

mechanisms.description: The order only revokes, restores, diminishes or eliminates lands from another order, or only authorizes one act within another order's lands; its command is spent when issued, and its effect is evidence for the other order.
mechanisms.effective_date_rule: The order date (an opening the Secretary dates later is a ministerial step).

mechanisms.description: A revocation that also opens the released land first to qualified ex-service men for 91 days from a date fixed by the order itself (for example the 63rd day after the order), then to the public: both commands are spent within months.
mechanisms.effective_date_rule: Order date plus 63 + 91 days at most; every such member is dated 1936 or earlier, so the period ended by 1937-06-30.

mechanisms.description: A later executive order (before 1942) or Public Land Order of the Secretary (after EO 9146, 9337 and 10355) revokes the order as a whole.
mechanisms.effective_date_rule: The revoking instrument's date (signature date for PLOs; a PLO may state a later effective date).

mechanisms.description: An Act of Congress revokes the order (the Pickett Act itself provides for revocation 'by an Act of Congress').

A withdrawal made under the Pickett Act or implied authority stays in force until revoked; FLPMA sec. 701(c) saved every withdrawal in effect on 1976-10-21, and sec. 704(a) repealed only the authority to make new ones.
FLPMA sec. 204(l) review of existing withdrawals in eleven western States: its recommendations led to many PLO revocations, which appear as M4 events; the review ends nothing by itself.

Resurvey withdrawals that by their terms remain in force only until the approved plat of resurvey is officially filed (or another date fixed by the Commissioner of the General Land Office), and revocations whose ex-service opening runs from that filing.
mechanisms.effective_date_rule: The plat filing date (not held for any member).

mechanisms.description: An official current land-status record or regulation shows the order or its operative effect in force: BLM's withdrawal case records (MLRS/LR2000) or the Code of Federal Regulations.

Power site reserves: Federal Power Act sec. 24 governs opening of reserved power-site lands (Commission determination, reserved right of re-entry); public water reserves and stock driveways rest on sec. 10 of the Stock-Raising Homestead Act. Neither ends a reserve.

An order whose only operative content amends another order merges into the parent on issue (strike-and-insert, D-20261021; coordinator ruling P2): its text continues as part of the parent until the parent ends, and the parent's lifecycle carries it.
